HALOCHINA — CONTENT AND DATA ATTRIBUTION

Vocabulary definitions (Vietnamese): CVDICT, Phong Phan.
https://github.com/ph0ngp/CVDICT
Based on CC-CEDICT, originally started by Paul Andrew Denisowski (1997).
https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cedict
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Dictionary cross-reference: Complete HSK Vocabulary, Yanis Zafirópulos.
https://github.com/drkameleon/complete-hsk-vocabulary
Original project code MIT (see DICTIONARY-LICENSE.txt).
Dictionary definitions retain CC-CEDICT's CC BY-SA 4.0 terms.

Level / pinyin factual cross-reference: HSK examination syllabus, November 2025,
Center for Language Education and Cooperation / Chinese Testing International.
Indexed by hsk-tutor.com / uranbekanarbaev:
https://github.com/uranbekanarbaev/hsk-3.0-vocabulary-dataset
https://www.chinesetest.cn/HSK
No examination papers, audio recordings or source syllabus PDFs are bundled.
Original syllabus rights remain with the respective rightsholders.

Vietnamese character readings: Unicode Unihan kVietnamese, Unicode, Inc.
https://www.unicode.org/charts/unihan.html
Unicode License V3; see UNICODE-LICENSE.txt.

Primary Sino-Vietnamese readings by pinyin: Phong Phan,
https://github.com/ph0ngp/hanviet-pinyin-wordlist
MIT License; see HANVIET-LICENSE.txt.

HaloChina modifications: selection of HSK 1–6 records, pronunciation-aware
dictionary matching, conversion of traditional character readings, a small
editorial reading map and explicit Vietnamese definition overrides.
The resulting vocabulary.js dictionary dataset is available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
Reusers must retain attribution, identify changes and share adapted dictionary
data under CC BY-SA 4.0. The downloadable CSVs carry this attribution too.

Vietnamese lessons, grammar explanations, example sentences, exercise prompts
and study guides were composed for HaloChina. Their placement by level is an
independent teaching sequence, not an official HSK grammar syllabus.

The app is independent and not affiliated with 123tiengtrung.com or any HSK
exam provider. No content from that website's document collection is bundled.
